Additionally, there are reports on Russian communities around the world that have sprung up in places as different as Ashdod, Israel and Brighton Beach, New York. CNN is also live every night from a range of iconic Moscow locations as Chance gives his topical insights into a country increasingly at the center of international headlines, to complement a range of interviews with top Russian CEOs and industry leaders airing throughout CNN's prime time evening programming. From St Basil's Cathedral, the Kremlin, Christ the Saviour Cathedral and Manej Square, Chance gives us the latest on what makes the Russia of today, from domestic and foreign policy, to business, to culture. The Eye on series has travelled around the world visiting France, Russia, India, South Korea, China, South Africa, Brazil, Beirut and Poland.

CNN (Cable News Network) is one of the world's most prominent 24-hour news broadcasters, founded in 1980 by Ted Turner. As a pioneer in continuous news coverage, CNN transformed how people around the world consume information, establishing a model that countless other networks would later follow. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, CNN has grown into a global media empire with bureaus spanning multiple continents.

## English as the Foundation

English serves as CNN's primary language of broadcast, reflecting its American origins and its role in connecting with audiences across the English-speaking world, including the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and numerous other nations. The network's English-language programming includes flagship shows, breaking news coverage, documentaries, and political analysis that reach millions of viewers daily. CNN's website and digital platforms also primarily operate in English, serving as a central hub for news consumption globally.

## Reaching Russian-Speaking Audiences

While English remains CNN's core language, the network has historically sought to engage Russian-speaking audiences as well. Understanding the geopolitical significance of Russia and the broader Russian-speaking world—including countries like Ukraine, Belarus, Kazakhstan, and various diaspora communities—CNN has at times provided content and coverage relevant to these regions. This has included Russian-language reporting during certain periods, translated content, and coverage specifically addressing events in Russia and neighboring countries.

The relationship between Western media outlets like CNN and Russian audiences has been complex, particularly given political tensions between Russia and Western nations. Access to CNN and other Western news sources in Russia has fluctuated depending on the political climate, with restrictions sometimes imposed on foreign media operating within Russian borders.

## Bridging Language and Culture

The interplay between English and Russian in CNN's broadcasting reflects broader themes in international journalism: the challenge of delivering objective, timely news across linguistic and cultural boundaries. As global events continue to unfold—from political developments to international conflicts—networks like CNN must navigate the complexities of serving diverse audiences while maintaining editorial standards and journalistic integrity.

CNN's efforts to bridge English and Russian-speaking audiences illustrate the broader challenges facing international news organizations in an increasingly interconnected yet politically divided world. As technology continues to evolve, the methods by which such networks reach multilingual audiences will likely continue to transform, adapting to new platforms and changing geopolitical realities.

## About the "Eye on" Series

CNN's "Eye on" franchise has built a reputation for in-depth, region-specific reporting that goes beyond headline news to explore the economic, cultural, and social fabric of countries and cities around the world. Previous installments have covered a range of global destinations, offering viewers nuanced insights into local business climates and innovation ecosystems.

For more information, broadcast schedules, and digital content access, visit CNN.com or follow CNN International's social media accounts.
